instruction.name: vinsgr2vr.b
instruction.description: Insert the low 8 bits of `b` into lane `imm` of `a`; the other lanes are unchanged.

latencies.notes: Latency from the inserted or index register to the vector destination. A chain that depends only on vd (vinsgr2vr.b $vr0, … writing $vr0 which it also reads) measures 1 cycle because the self-dependency is handled by renaming, so the latency is measured as a round trip through vpickve2gr.b (5.99 cycles) with the 3-cycle pick subtracted, which leaves 3.
